Hi Tom / Anne / Cortex procurement team —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we transition toward your contract renewal later this quarter, I wanted to pull together an initial kickoff to align timelines, stakeholder owners, and any term / capacity asks you expect to bake into the renewal. High-level goals from Redwood: preserve current latency SLOs, keep unit economics stable via a staged uplift, and ensure a clear QBR cadence for product/usage review.

Draft agenda for this thread:
- Confirm renewal target date and preferred term length (12 / 24 months)
- Confirm committed capacity baseline and expected burst needs (tokens / concurrency)
- Identify procurement decision owner and legal contact for fast-track redlines
- QBR scheduling window and who from your execs/ops should attend
- Next steps and deliverables (MAP, updated SOW, DSIG/contract links)

Attached is a quick first-pass committed changes doc and a mutual action plan template we can iterate on. Please flag any missing stakeholders.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please reply with preferred renewal month and term preference by Friday 3/5
2) If you want to hold a 30-min kickoff, propose Wed 3/10 10–10:30am PT or Thu 3/11 1–1:30pm PT
3) Procurement: if you can share a list of legal contacts for parallel review, we’ll prepare a redline-ready SOW

Attachments: [Cortex_Committed_Changes_v1.pdf (pdf), MAP_Cortex_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

- Target renewal: aim to execute by end of April (contract must start 2027-05-01)
- Term: leaning toward 24 months but want a pricing ladder that reflects usage tiers
- Capacity: baseline today is ~200M tokens/month; expect burst capability to ~350M for seasonal campaigns — we'll validate with engineering next week
- Procurement / Legal: procurement@cortexhealth.com is the intake address; legal review will be handled by Anne Richards (cc’d)

We can do Wed 3/10 10–10:30am PT for a kickoff — confirm and I’ll add the calendar invite. Also — two asks ahead of the call:
1) Can you send an example of a staircase pricing option (12/18/24 month) and any unit price assumptions?
2) We need an initial list of telemetry artifacts for our compliance team (audit logs, retention controls) — if Karthik can chime in there that’d be great.
